title: Dimension zero: a minimizing 0-current supported in the constraint set vanishes
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_0(U) minimizing in A (IsMinimizingIn T A, Simon 7.1.1; for n = 0 the boundary condition is vacuous) with spt T ⊆ A. Then T = 0, spt T = ∅, and M_W(T) = 0 for every W ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → T.support ⊆ A → T = 0 ∧ T.support = ∅ ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W = 0
